$comment: Map of Susana's systeme.io automations (captured read-only 2026-10-21) and how each maps onto the email_boss sequences in yonisync/sequences/. Source of truth for the automations flowchart site (../automations).
delay_semantics: Each delay counts from the previous email in the campaign (systeme: 'This email will be sent after' previous email + delay). No send-time or weekday restrictions on any email.

rules.note: Same actions as rule #4 (different form). A contact who opts in on both forms is only enrolled once.
Same actions as rule #2 (homepage form instead of the checklist opt-in page).
Sends the purchase welcome to anyone who submits the form on the sales page, before (or without) buying. Probably intended for the order form; please confirm.
Same actions as rule #12 (and the 'Purchased Yoni Flow' workflow), on a different order page.

trigger.label: Page visited
trigger.step: Thank You Page Yoni Flow Upsell - Free Webinar Page

rules.note: Tags 'Book A Call Page View' on a thank-you/webinar page, not the Book a Call page. Possibly a copy-paste slip; please confirm.
Adds the checklist tag but does NOT subscribe to the Checklist Campaign (tags alone do not start campaigns in systeme).
Same trigger and actions as the 'Purchased Yoni Flow' workflow: in systeme a buyer on this page likely received the welcome email twice.

workflows.name: Purchased Yoni Flow
workflows.note: Workflow, not a rule. No delay step: the email goes out right after the tag is added. Duplicates rule #12.

unlinked.note: No systeme automation rule or workflow subscribes anyone to the 'Fertiilty Type Quiz' campaign. Contacts were most likely added by the Typeform integration or by hand. In email_boss it starts when someone completes the new quiz (signup source 'fertility-quiz').

email_boss_mapping.subscribe_campaign: add tag seq:<sequence-key> (each sequence's trigger is tag_added on that tag, so plain tags like 'freebie checklist-optin' never start a sequence by themselves, same as systeme)
email_boss_mapping.send_email: add tag seq:yoni-flow-welcome (one-step sequence, sent once per contact)
email_boss_mapping.add_tag: add the tag, normalised to lowercase with spaces as dashes, e.g. 'freebie checklist-optin' -> freebie-checklist-optin, 'tag: yoni flow offer buyer' -> yoni-flow-offer-buyer
